name: The Secret Society: Hidden Object Adventure
description:
About This Game

Uncover the secrets of a magical society!

Your beloved uncle has vanished, leaving behind a trail of cryptic clues and unanswered questions. Travel to his mysterious manor, discover your own extraordinary powers, and begin an unforgettable hidden-object adventure filled with secrets, puzzles, and unexpected twists.

You are the newest member of the Secret Society, a clandestine order whose members can travel between magical worlds. Explore enchanting locations, search detailed scenes for hidden objects, collect valuable treasures, and solve challenging riddles as you investigate your uncle's disappearance.

But his fate is only the beginning. A powerful threat is closing in on the Society, and you may be the only one capable of protecting its sacred Artifact.

Key Features:
• Explore a mysterious manor and a wide variety of magical worlds
• Search beautifully detailed scenes for hidden objects and vital clues
• Solve unique puzzles, riddles, and match-3 challenges
• Complete quests and piece together the truth behind your uncle's disappearance
• Combine discovered items into valuable collections
• Meet intriguing characters and experience a story filled with surprising twists
• Receive daily bonuses and enjoy regularly added quests

Enter a world of hidden treasures, ancient secrets, and magical intrigue. Join the Secret Society and uncover the truth!

While this game is absolutely free to play, you have the ability to unlock optional bonuses via in-app purchases from within the game. You may disable in-app purchases in your device settings.


You can play this game even if you’re offline!

Game available in: English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish.
